import * as ARA3D from '../src/index'; import { showFilter } from './filterPanel.js'; import * as THREE from 'three'; async function runExample() { const viewer = new ARA3D.Viewer(); const loader = new ARA3D.BimOpenSchemaLoader(); console.time('Loading .bos file'); const bimData = await loader.load('/ara3d-webgl/Snowdon Towers Sample Architectural.bos'); console.timeEnd('Loading .bos file'); let group = bimData.ThreeGeometry; viewer.add(group); } runExample();
